source_of_truth: Derived by hand from the build I wrote. The NESTED route /settings/billing (manifest key "/settings/billing/page") lists static/chunks/billing-tables.js in clientModules with async:false, so it is in the route's INITIAL set. That chunk is 210000 bytes raw of high-entropy base64; under gzipSync it is ~158192 bytes, which kb() rounds to ~154.5 KB gzip -- just over route-attribution's 150 KB cutoff, and it is the single largest initial chunk. A nested route shipping a ~154 KB gzip chunk on first load is a genuine initial-weight defect just over threshold. route-heavy-initial-chunk is HEURISTIC by design, so heuristic is the strongest honest level; the finding is path-attributed, so line is null.
provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from source without consulting tool output
